items.title: Charles Tolliver interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 6, 2021 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and I’m very pleased to have a follow up session with Charles Tolliver. Welcome, sir, nice to see you again. [INTERVIEWEE] Good to see you.

ctx.x: Part II was conducted via Zoom on May 21, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
